jobs.error.NOT_FOUND: Job {id} was not found — it may have been removed by retention.
jobs.error.UNAVAILABLE: The queue provider is not connected ({state}) — jobs cannot be read or changed.
jobs.error.NON_RETRYABLE: Job {id} failed with a non-retryable error ({error}) — retrying would fail again.
jobs.error.NOT_CANCELLABLE: The processor of queue {queue} does not support cooperative cancellation — a running job cannot be cancelled.
jobs.error.NO_WORKER: No worker is listening for job commands — the running job cannot receive a cancellation request.
jobs.error.TOO_MANY: At most {max} jobs can be retried at once ({count} selected).
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.waiting: The job is waiting — this action is not available.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.active: The job is running — this action is not available.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.stalled: The job is stalled — this action is not available.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.failed: The job has failed — this action is not available.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.retrying: The job is waiting for its next retry — this action is not available.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.delayed: The job is delayed — this action is not available.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.cancelled: The job has already been cancelled.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.changed: The job changed state (a worker may have just picked it up) — refresh and try again.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.removed: The job was removed from the queue — its payload is no longer available.
jobs.error.INVALID_STATE.unknown: The job is not in a state that allows this action.
jobs.problem.NO_WORKER: {count} job(s) waiting in {queue} but no worker is consuming it
jobs.problem.STALLED: {count} stalled job(s) detected — no heartbeat from the worker
jobs.problem.RETRY_STORM: Retry storm: {count} retry attempts in the last minute (mostly {type} · {error})
jobs.problem.FAILURES: {count} job(s) failed during the last hour
jobs.problem.BACKLOG_GROWING: Job backlog is growing (+{diff}/min incoming over processing)
jobs.event.job_stalled: Job #{job} ({type}) detected stalled — lost its worker heartbeat
jobs.event.job_stalled_worker: Job #{job} was stalled — the worker lost its lock; BullMQ moved it back to waiting
